title: P5-05: Publication repo AnthusAI/p.apyr.us scaffold on the packages, with legacy-path redirects
description:
## Goal
New repository `AnthusAI/p.apyr.us` on the published packages: brand `papyrus` moved out of the Papyrus repo's brand table, `papyrus.config.ts` with `readerBasePath: "/information"` and `rootRoute` untouched, the one-line `amplify/backend.ts`, `infra/site.json`, a placeholder site-owned `app/page.tsx` (marketing lands in P5-06), and the legacy-path redirects.

## Context (FACT)
- Pilobol.us is the worked example (papyrus.config.ts `defineSite({ brands, defaultBrand, backend })`, `amplify/backend.ts` = `defineSiteBackend(site)`, `infra/site.json`).
- Today p.apyr.us builds the Papyrus repo directly: root `amplify/backend.ts` is `defineSiteBackend({ backend: { productionAppId: "dbsyytcm9drqa" } })`, root `amplify.yml` builds, and the app is on `main` (97 commits behind develop; last good job 336 on 2026-10-05, commit d04b068).
- Newspaper content: the live `/` renders an empty edition ("Page -- of --"); `/2026/october/07` returns HTTP 500; PublishedItem, Item, Edition, PublishedEdition all have 0 rows. Layout today = brand `papyrus` default (newsprint). Keep layout and brand text unchanged (Q3).
- Legacy paths to redirect to the new mount (permanent): `/YYYY/<month>/DD[/page/N|/section/<k>|/<slug>]` -> `/information/YYYY/...`; `/articles/<slug>` -> `/information/articles/<slug>`; `/archive` -> `/information/archive`; `/settings` -> `/information/settings`. `/newsroom` and `/api` do not move. `/` is marketing (no redirect).
- Redirects live in the repo's `next.config` (`redirects()` with `permanent: true`), version-controlled and testable; the apex redirect stays in `infra/site.json` (P5-03).

## Exact steps
1. Ryan creates the empty repo (or says yes to `gh repo create AnthusAI/p.apyr.us --public`).
2. Scaffold PR: files above, exact pin of the P5-02 prerelease, `.gitignore` for generated shims, AGENTS.md, `redirectUrls` in backend.auth: `http://localhost:3001/newsroom`, `https://main.<appId>.amplifyapp.com/newsroom` (placeholder until P5-07), `https://p.apyr.us/newsroom`, `https://staging.p.apyr.us/newsroom`.
3. Gherkin: "an old dated URL answers 308/301 to the /information equivalent", "/newsroom does not redirect", "/ is not redirected".
4. Papyrus repo side (separate PR in Papyrus, after cutover only, see P5-12): remove brand.

## Acceptance checks
- `npm ci && npx papyrus-app sync && npm run build` green; local `next start`: `curl -I /2026/october/07` returns 301/308 with `Location: /information/2026/october/07`; `/articles/x`, `/archive` likewise; `/newsroom` 200; `/information` 200.
- `papyrus-infra synth` validates `infra/site.json`.
- CI green on the PR.

## Rollback
Delete the repo; nothing is deployed from it yet.

## Risks
Regex precedence between the dated route and `/newsroom`; month names are lowercase English words (match `[a-z]+`).

## Needs Ryan
Repo creation; PR merge.
